listing.name: UNSF v1.0.0 - FULL RELEASE
listing.summary: United Nation Space Force is Stargate inspired mod, that adds well Stargate stuff
listing.aiSummary: Adds a Stargate-inspired faction with new ships, weapons, hullmods, and a trinary star system.

description: Introduces a new human faction inspired by the Stargate universe. Features include many new ships, weapons, and hullmods, along with Zero Point Modules (ZPMs) and hidden lore. The content focuses on adaptations of existing art for vessels like the Daedalus and Apollo.
